name: @openagt/remote-access
description: Open OpenAgent on a phone or another browser: a device gets in by scanning a QR code once, each device has its own key and is removed alone, and one switch, Phone on Wi-Fi, opens the door on the network the computer is on. It brings the Devices section of the dashboard's Settings page.

scripts.prepack: node -e "if(!process.env.npm_config_user_agent?.startsWith('pnpm/')){console.error('Pack and publish with pnpm: it replaces workspace:* with the real version, npm does not');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test --test-timeout=60000 'dist-test/**/*.test.js' && cd dashboard && vitest run
